intro.text: An Alethi ardent serving the queen in the palace at Kholinar.

items.text: Lhan was assigned to show Pai around the queen's palace in Kholinar. He explained that the queen gave her ardents easy lives because she feared the Almighty was displeased with her, and tried to show Pai the palace's luxuries, without making her happy about any of it. The next morning he was horrified to see her graffiti likening the queen to each of the ten fools.
